title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Guarantee Standing Share Table
content:
In a shown-pay claim on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the guarantee standing share multiplies the guaranteed offer figure. The share follows the active violation points on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

| Active violation points | Guarantee standing share |
|---|---|
| None | 1.00 |
| One to three | 0.97 |
| Four or more | 0.95 |

## Notes to the table

- The points are the account's active violation points balance at the time of handling.
- The share multiplies the guaranteed offer figure itself; the result is not rounded at this point.
- Three points and one point receive the same share (0.97); four points is the first figure at which the share falls to 0.95.

## Hypothetical figures

| Guaranteed offer figure | Active points | Figure after the share |
|---|---|---|
| 18.00 | 0 | 18.00 |
| 18.00 | 2 | 18.00 multiplied by 0.97 is 17.46 |
| 18.00 | 6 | 18.00 multiplied by 0.95 is 17.10 |
